_: The values README.md's badges render. Regenerate with `python -m tests.badges`; tests/test_badges_agree.py refuses a drift.

judged.label: e2e
judged.note: Guard 1. 3,316 of 7,512 statements, from the 58 tests that judge a scientific output against the truth that generated the data. **`oracle`-marked tests are excluded**, which is what makes the name honest -- the badge beside it already claims that word. Adding them reaches 46.10 per cent, so they are worth 147 statements and 1.96 points over an identical denominator. The floor is CI's, decided by #157 over `end2end or oracle`; this selection is a strict subset of that one and clears it by 2.44 points. The denominator grew 7,031 to 7,512 when #239, #242 and #249 merged: a new port module is counted whether or not an `end2end` test reaches it, so the figure fell 44.80 to 44.14 without any test being removed. Not subtractable from `all`: see #223.

oracle.label: oracle
oracle.note: Guard 2. Measured over its own denominator so the figure cannot rise by importing more of upstream, which validates nothing about cnaster. 1,211 of 2,582 statements. `opt/emission_mixture`, `opt/mixture` and `CountPairEmission` joined the surface on #232, because port's claims started resting on them: the denominator grew 2,164 to 2,582 and the covered count 947 to 1,209, so the figure rose 43.76 to 46.82 and the floor was raised with it. #232 predicted a fall to 36.88 on the assumption the joining modules would arrive uncovered; they did not. Merging `main` (#239, #242, #249) reached 2 further statements, 1,209 to 1,211, and the figure moved 46.82 to 46.90 over an unchanged denominator.

reach.label: all
reach.selection: not release and not (end2end or oracle)
reach.note: Guard 3. Proposed by #159 and not wired into CI -- its 'Done when' asks for exactly that and is unmet, which is why this is the badge that went stale furthest. 5,185 of 7,865 statements, from a clean run: 568 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed. It read 71.52 per cent over 7,329 statements at 7b12d7c; #238, #239, #242, #249 and #237 added 536 statements to the denominator and the figure fell 5.60 points without a test being removed. The denominator is 353 statements larger than guard 1's on the same tree, so the two are not subtractable: #223. An earlier reading was diagnosed here as test pollution and was not; the record said so wrongly until baae1a3.

whole_run._intent: run_cnaster patched against --no-patch, wall time and peak RSS, each arm in its own process. key_instance (10,000 x 5,000) does not fit unpatched -- 8 GB of emission array against 15 GB available (#90) -- so the comparison runs at the largest instance both arms complete and the badge label carries it. This measurement is #91.
whole_run.arms_are: `--no-patch`, nothing rebound, against the entry point's default: SWAPS plus FIGURE_SWAPS. The figure swaps are in the default as of 1c0a496, so this is what a user gets rather than what the bitwise-reproducing subset gets.
whole_run.note: **No ratio: the baseline arm cannot complete at this instance.** The figures this badge carried -- 1.5941x runtime and 3.0734x memory, median of 3 pairs at 4000x1980x5 on 7b12d7c -- are withdrawn rather than carried forward, because `speed` and `mem` are the two badges CI never checks and a ratio nobody can reproduce is worse than an absent one. Nothing installed changed in between: `SWAPS` and `FIGURE_SWAPS` are byte-identical to 7b12d7c, eight of the nine installed replacement modules are unchanged, and the ninth moved by 13 lines (#249's `label_solver` branch, which defaults to `icm`). So the withdrawal is about what the host can run, not about the patch. `_probe` records the attempt and what it established.

_probe.why: The unpatched arm no longer completes at 4000x1980x5. Measured four times: three paired runs and one probe with the host otherwise idle, SIGKILL every time at 12.124-12.128 GB of the 16,095 MB available. The host has no cgroup cap, so this is the arm's requirement rather than contention -- #90's 'does not fit unpatched' arriving at the stress instance, not only at key_instance.
_probe.pending: Three pairs at the largest instance whose unpatched arm completes; 3800 is being probed between the two above, because scaling down further than the measurement needs would understate the claim.
